## Magic level

* Levels 1-20. Level *n* → *n*+1 needs **30 + 22·n** magic XP.
* XP: casting (2 + mana/10), monsters (6), Dark Disciples (16), the Devil (260), ancient pages (60), sealing a Devil Gate (120), bosses (400 killer / 200 helpers), crimson-night devils (+25).
* **Max mana** = 100 + 12 per level above 1, +40 Golden Dawn, +15 Blue Rose, +5 per Magic Knight rank, +30 Mana Heart amulet.
* **Mana regeneration** = 3 + 0.3 per level per second (Black Bull ×1.25, Aqua Deer ×1.3 while moving, Mana Heart ×1.2). It pauses while you fly a broom.
* **Level 12** opens your grimoire's new move (v0.6.0); **level 15** awakens its strongest spell (except Anti-Magic).
* **Spell power** = +5% per level above 1, with robe bonuses.

## Magic Knight ranks (stars)

Stars come from great deeds: Devil +5, Leviathan +5, Dungeon Guardian +3, Tidewatch Commodore +2, Raider Captain +1, every 5 magic levels +1, sealing a Devil Gate +1, the giant bosses +5 to +9 (half for helpers), missions +1 to +3. Each rank adds +5 max mana.

| Stars | Rank |
|---|---|
| 0 | Junior Magic Knight |
| 3 | Intermediate Magic Knight |
| 8 | Senior Magic Knight |
| 15 | First Class Senior Magic Knight |
| 25 | Vice-Captain |
| 40 | Magic Knight Captain |
| 60 | Wizard King Candidate |

## Squad robes

All robes are chest armour (6 armour points), enchantable and repairable with mana crystals. The first three are craftable; the rest come from dungeon chests.

| Robe | Perk |
|---|---|
| Black Bull Robe | +25% mana regen, +25% spell power below 40% health |
| Golden Dawn Robe | +40 max mana, +10% spell power |
| Crimson Lion Robe | Flame spells cost 15% less and hit 15% harder |
| Silver Eagle Robe | +20% spell power while your mana is above 75% |
| Blue Rose Robe | Healing and shield spells are 30% stronger; +15 max mana |
| Green Mantis Robe | Spell cooldowns are 15% shorter |
| Coral Peacock Robe | Every cast has a 20% chance to refund its mana |
| Purple Orca Robe | Water breathing, and Water/Ice spells hit 15% harder |
| Aqua Deer Robe | Swiftness while out of combat, and +30% mana regen while moving |

## Your bounty & the Tidewatch

Defeating captains, devils, the Leviathan, Tidewatch officers or other ships raises the **bounty on your head**. Each new tier gives you a Wanted Poster of yourself, and the Tidewatch sends squads to hunt you - Sentinels, and at higher bounties Commodores who sidestep blows and call down cannon bombardments.

| Bounty | Title |
|---|---|
| 300 | Small-time Pirate |
| 1500 | Notorious Pirate |
| 5000 | Sea Tyrant |
| 12000 | Scourge of the Seas |

## Daily missions

Every in-game day each player is dealt **three missions**: an easy one, a harder one and a wild card. Progress counts anywhere - kills (yours, and your companions' for kill missions), bosses and Devil Gates (everyone nearby gets credit), spells and fruit powers cast, magic XP earned. **Delivery** missions take the items from your pack at the board. Turn missions in at a **Mission Board** (craft one or find one in a Magic Knight camp); the board also swaps an unstarted mission (free once a day, then 25 doubloons). Finish all three for a bonus of 4 Mana Crystals.

| Mission | Kind | Target | Count | Tier |
|---|---|---|---|---|

| **Clear out the Imps** | defeat | `bc:imp` | 10 | ★ |
| **Hunt down Hellhounds** | defeat | `bc:hellhound` | 4 | ★★ |
| **Drive off the Sea Raiders** | defeat | `bc_pirate` | 8 | ★ |
| **Banish Mana Wraiths** | defeat | `bc:mana_wraith` | 4 | ★★ |
| **Bring Rogue Mages to justice** | defeat | `bc:rogue_mage` | 5 | ★★ |
| **Patrol: defeat 30 monsters** | defeat | `monster` | 30 | ★ |
| **Defeat a great foe (any boss)** | defeat any boss | `boss` | 1 | ★★★ |
| **Seal a Devil Gate** | seal | `bc:devil_gate` | 1 | ★★ |

## Amulets

Hold one in your **off hand**. Craft them (gold nuggets, string, a mana crystal and a focus), buy a Mystery Amulet from the merchant, or find one in camp chests.

| Amulet | Id | Effect |
|---|---|---|
| Mana Heart | `bc:amulet_mana` | +30 max mana and 20% faster mana regeneration |
| Swift Sigil | `bc:amulet_swift` | Spell cooldowns 12% shorter |
| Battle Charm | `bc:amulet_power` | +12% spell power |
| Guardian Ward | `bc:amulet_guard` | Resistance II while below 40% health |
| Vigor Band | `bc:amulet_vigor` | Two extra hearts and faster healing |

## Magic brooms

Use a broom to mount it. **Look** where you want to go and **hold forward** to fly (look up to climb, down to dive), **hold back** to brake, let go to **hover**, **sneak** to step off - the broom flies back into your pack, and you float down gently. Flying drinks mana and your mana does not regenerate while you fly; run dry and the broom glides down until 15% of your mana is back. Without a grimoire a broom can only glide; Anti-Magic smothers it entirely.

| Broom | Top speed | Mana per second (hovering: 40%) |
|---|---|---|
| Magic Broom | 11 blocks/s | 1.5 |
| Swift Broom | 17 blocks/s | 2.5 |
